This is a what-if simulation. If a ramp were built at the unnamed steps, 3 of the 5 sampled wheelchair journeys would be confirmed, up from 1 today. The number of journeys that would reach their destination stays at 3, so the change is in how confident the routes are, not in which places can be reached.
Worth knowing:
• Imagined changes are not real; unverified facts stay unverified.
• Segment facts are demo values, not yet surveyed.
• Two of the 5 sampled journeys have no mapped connection (data gap) and would stay that way in this simulation.
• The steps are an unnamed set in the township data, so this does not identify a specific location.
